span.label: **THE DEFINITION IS A TRIPLE REFUSAL TO CONDITION ON ANYTHING THAT HAPPENED AFTER RANDOMISATION** - `REGARDLESS OF their adherence with the entry criteria, REGARDLESS OF the treatment they actually received, and REGARDLESS OF subsequent withdrawal from treatment or deviation from the protocol`
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: and the reason is that the alternative destroys what randomisation bought: `If noncompliant subjects and dropouts are EXCLUDED from the final analysis, it might create IMPORTANT PROGNOSTIC DIFFERENCES among treatment groups` - and subjects `may be noncompliant or may drop out DUE TO THEIR RESPONSE OF TREATMENT`
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: **THE COST IS PAID IN THE SAME COIN.** `In ITT analysis, estimate of treatment effect is generally CONSERVATIVE because of DILUTION due to noncompliance` - the property that makes it unbiased is the property that makes it small
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: so the criticism is symmetrical: ITT `has been criticized for being TOO CAUTIOUS and thus being MORE SUSCEPTIBLE TO TYPE II ERROR`
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: **AND THE TWO POPULATIONS FAIL IN OPPOSITE DIRECTIONS, WHICH IS WHY THE CHOICE IS NOT NEUTRAL.** `ITT tends to make the two treatments LOOK SIMILAR, WHEREAS the PP removes patients who do not complete treatment and is MORE ABLE TO REFLECT TREATMENT DIFFERENCES`
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: **THE MODIFIED VARIANT HAS NO STABLE DEFINITION AT ALL** - `the definition given to the modified ITT (mITT) in randomized controlled trial has been found to be IRREGULAR AND ARBITRARY because there is a LACK OF CONSISTENT GUIDELINES for its application. The mITT analysis ALLOWS A SUBJECTIVE APPROACH IN ENTRY CRITERIA`
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: and it is not one population but many: `multiple mITT populations CAN BE DEFINED FOR A SINGLE STUDY such as clinical mITT and microbiological mITT`
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: **THE SAME OBJECT CARRIES A THIRD NAME FROM A THIRD AUTHORITY** - ICH E9 `uses the term FULL ANALYSIS SET to describe the analysis set which is as complete as possible and AS CLOSE AS POSSIBLE TO THE ITT IDEAL`
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: **The guidelines do not agree about where the principle applies.** `Whereas the importance of the ITT population analysis in superiority designs has been well accepted, however THERE IS NO CONSENSUS ABOUT ITS ROLE IN NON-INFERIORITY TRIALS`
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: and the proposed resolution is to require both and hope they agree - `noninferiority should be concluded ONLY IF BOTH ITT AND PP ANALYSES PERMIT THAT` - which is a procedure rather than a principle, and the paper notes the conservative effect of PP on such trials `has not been thoroughly explored`
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: **the remedy offered for the missing data ITT cannot ignore is itself contested** - last observation carried forward, `whereby the LAST AVAILABLE MEASUREMENT for each individual at the time point prior to withdrawal IS RETAINED in the analysis`, presented here without its known bias
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: **This is a narrative review for beginners, not a systematic one.** No search strategy, no inclusion criteria and no synthesis are reported; the claims about what the literature finds - including the central one about mITT - are carried by citation
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: and the practical advice at the end withdraws the problem rather than solving it: `Anyone who follows these principles intelligently and has a vision to minimize bias SHOULD NOT WORRY FURTHER ABOUT 'INTENTION TO TREAT'`
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: ITT `gives an UNBIASED ESTIMATE of treatment effect` and its estimate `is generally CONSERVATIVE because of DILUTION due to noncompliance`. **Both sentences are true and they describe one mechanism** - keeping the noncompliers is what preserves the randomisation and what shrinks the difference. A reader who quotes either alone has quoted half of it.
